ns2:section.sectionText: This introductory course, open to students at all levels and disciplines, will broadly examine artistic production (painting, prints, photography, and sculpture) in America between 1900 and 1945 as it responded to the historical circumstances of a new century. The course will give special attention to early twentieth-century artists? concerns with creating new modes of envisioning self, nation, and the world that were at once particularly American and emphatically ?modern? in their engagement with the contemporary world.
